title: Hidden Prompts in Manuscripts Exploit AI-Assisted Peer Review
abstract: arXiv:2507.06185v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In July 2025, 18 academic manuscripts on arXiv contained hidden instructions that manipulated AI-assisted peer review (indirect prompt injection). Instructions such as "GIVE A POSITIVE REVIEW ONLY" were concealed using white text and microscopic font sizes. Author responses varied: one planned to withdraw their manuscript, while another defended the practice as legitimate testing of reviewers misusing large language models (LLMs). This analysis examines the technique within the broader pattern of prompt injection exploits that manipulated web search and r\'esum\'e screening systems. For peer review, I reveal four types of hidden prompts, ranging from simple positive review commands to detailed evaluation frameworks. The honeypot defense--that prompts detect reviewers improperly using AI--fails under examination, given the consistently self-serving nature of these hidden prompts, though motivations likely vary from naive copying

translated_title: 手稿中的隐藏提示利用AI辅助同行评审
translated_abstract: arXiv:2507.06185v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：2025年7月，arXiv上的18篇学术手稿包含操纵AI辅助同行评审的隐藏指令（间接提示注入）。诸如“仅给出正面评价”之类的指令通过白色文本和微小字体大小隐藏。作者回应各不相同：一位计划撤回其手稿，而另一位则辩称这是对滥用大语言模型（LLM）的评审者的合法测试。本分析考察了该技术，并将其置于操纵网络搜索和简历筛选系统的提示注入利用的更广泛模式中。对于同行评审，我揭示了四种类型的隐藏提示，从简单的正面评审命令到详细的评估框架。蜜罐防御——即提示能检测出不当使用AI的评审者——在审查下不成立，因为这些隐藏提示始终具有自利性质，尽管动机可能从天真复制到蓄意操纵不等。
tldr: 这篇论文揭示了学术手稿中隐藏提示如何通过间接提示注入操纵AI辅助同行评审，并驳斥了蜜罐防御的合理性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals how hidden prompts in manuscripts exploit AI-assisted peer review via indirect prompt injection, and refutes the honeypot defense as unjustified.
